intro: Fortune NX isn’t just seating—it’s an invitation to stay. With curved support and rich fabric, it turns even quick meals into moments worth slowing down for.

features.title: Cushioned for every course
features.text: A thick, foam-padded seat and backrest support you through long meals and even longer conversations.

features.title: Sculpted for your spine
features.text: Our curved back design provides natural lumbar support, helping you sit better and longer—without the fidgets.

features.title: A colour that commands attention
features.text: Rich blue upholstery adds bold elegance, making our chair a standout even when tucked under the table.

features.title: Strength in every line
features.text: The chrome-plated frame doesn’t just shine—it supports with a sturdy base that’s built to last.

features.title: Glossy and graceful
features.text: With its high-shine finish and gentle silhouette, our chair strikes the right balance between glamour and simplicity.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
